# Miranda Faria

> Miranda Faria is a small software and design studio run by Eduardo Miranda Faria, based in Piumhi, Minas Gerais, Brazil. It builds custom business systems, websites, brand identity and AI automation, and two products: Pulso RH (time-clock, absence and HR indicators for factories in Brazil) and Eightyfive (attendance records for English language schools in Ireland). The site is bilingual: Portuguese at /pt and English at /en.

Miranda Faria works from diagnosis to delivery with one person accountable for the whole project. Systems are handed over in the client's name: the client runs them and keeps the data and access.

## Products

- [Pulso RH (PT)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/pt/pulso-rh): HR operations for factories. Reads the AFD file that Brazilian time clocks generate (Portaria MTP 671/2021 and the older 1510 layout), the time-keeping system exports (CSV, Excel, HTML, PDF) and the employee list from payroll (PDF). Shows the daily attendance sheet with one-click justification, absenteeism by day, sector and month, overtime with its cost, hour bank, HR alerts (probation, holidays, consecutive absences, CLT points), job schedules by validity, per-sector dashboards, and culture and compliance (whistleblowing channel, development plans, access by role). Offer: a free diagnosis of one month of clock data. No need to change the time clock.
- [Pulso RH demo](https://apontador-demo.base44.app): public demo with fictional factories; visitors can import their own file, which is read in the browser.
- [Eightyfive (EN)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/en/eightyfive): attendance register for English language schools in Ireland listed on ILEP or authorised to use the TrustEd Ireland mark. Applies the 15-minute rule, records the class teacher's student count, flags 25% or more uncertified absence in the first six weeks, forecasts each student against the 85% attendance requirement and exports the full record.
- [Eightyfive demo](https://eightyfive.base44.app): demo with sample data.

## Services

- [Systems and management (PT)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/pt/gestao) / [EN](https://mirandafaria.com.br/en/gestao): custom management systems (stock, sales, attendance, KPIs).
- [Development (PT)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/pt/desenvolvimento) / [EN](https://mirandafaria.com.br/en/desenvolvimento): websites, web systems and apps.
- [Design (PT)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/pt/design) / [EN](https://mirandafaria.com.br/en/design): brand identity and interface design.
- [Automation (PT)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/pt/automacao) / [EN](https://mirandafaria.com.br/en/automacao): AI and WhatsApp automation of repetitive work.
- [All services (PT)](https://mirandafaria.com.br/pt/servicos) / [EN](https://mirandafaria.com.br/en/servicos)
